editDevicePositionsControlSheet.descript: Spatial mapping allows us to intelligently design the lighting distribution in your physical space.
editDevicePositionsControlSheet.howItWor:
Transform your lighting experience with spatial mapping! Hue SpatialAware™ technology analyses the layout of your room and the placement of your lights to intelligently design the lighting distribution in your space.

Just scan your room and the lights in it with your mobile device and we'll take it from there.
editDevicePositionsControlSheet.lightSel: Select lights you want to rescan and tap Rescan. You may need to rescan some existing lights for calibration purposes, and if you have new lights available, you need to add those too.
editDevicePositionsControlSheet.qualityI: To get the best possible experience with spatial mapping, keep the following in mind:<olist><litem>All lights in the room should be scanned. If you add a light to the room, make sure to also add it to the spatial map.</litem><litem>If you physically move a light to a new location within the room, you should rescan that light.</litem><litem>Colour-capable lights will vastly improve the lighting experience.</litem><litem>Lights placed at different heights across your room will improve the functionality of the spatial map.</litem></olist>

roomScanning.howToScan.lidar.subtitle:
Rescanning an existing light? <olist><litem>Make sure to aim at the same location that you originally scanned. If you scanned a physical light (i.e. a lamp), rescan that same light. If you scanned a light effect – for example, on a wall – rescan that same light effect.</litem><litem>Follow the steps below for all lights you wish to scan or rescan.</litem></olist> 

Adding a new light? <olist><litem>Aim at the blinking light (this can be a physical light fixture or a light effect).</litem>
<litem>Tap the blue plus icon.</litem>
<litem>Verify the location of the pin to ensure it matches the location of the light.</litem>
<litem>Tap <emph>OK, next</emph> to continue with the next light.</litem></olist>
roomScanning.howToScan.lidar.title: Get help
roomScanning.howToScan.nonLidar.subtitle:
Rescanning an existing light? 
<olist><litem>Make sure to aim at the same location that you originally scanned. If you scanned a physical light (i.e. a lamp), rescan that same light. If you scanned a light effect – for example, on a wall – rescan that same light effect.</litem>
<litem>Follow the steps below for all lights you wish to scan or rescan.</litem></olist>

Adding a new light? 
<olist><litem>Aim at the blinking light (this can be a physical light fixture or a light effect).</litem>
<litem>Tap the blue plus icon.</litem>
<litem>Take a step to the left or right, then aim at the light again.</litem>
<litem>Tap the blue plus icon again. By scanning from a different angle, you can register the light more accurately.</litem>
<litem>Verify the location of the pin to ensure it matches the location of the light.</litem>
<litem>Tap <emph>OK, next</emph> to continue with the next light.</litem></olist>

roomScanning.lightsScanning.title: Scan your lights
We can’t continue to add new lights to your spatial map because you’ve skipped too many existing lights that we needed for calibration purposes. 

Follow these steps to add new lights: <olist><litem>Go to <emph>Room</emph> > <emph>Edit Room</emph> > <emph>Edit spatial map</emph> and add more lights.</litem>
<litem>If you are unable to rescan existing lights, you can delete the spatial map entirely and create a new one.</litem></olist>

smartScenes.learnMore.description.natura:
Natural light uses different shades of warm-to-cool white light that are designed to help you stay productive and feel supported in your overall wellbeing. 
 
 Your lights will automatically transit throughout the day: start with bright, cool tones to energise your mornings and end with a warmer, golden glow to help you relax as the sun goes down.
smartScenes.learnMore.title.naturalLight: Natural light: shades of white throughout the day
smartScenes.preview.explanation.goldenHo: From gentle morning tones to the relaxing glows of golden hour and into evening, this All-day scene transitions automatically throughout the day. Once saved, tap the pencil icon next to the scene's card to edit each time slot.
smartScenes.preview.explanation.naturalL: Let your lights change automatically — all day long! Natural light is a 24-hour scene designed to give you the best light to help you stay productive and feel supported throughout the day. Tap the play button to see a sped-up version of the scene.

Let your lights change automatically – all day long! This 24-hour scene gives you the best light throughout the day. Automatically adjust to the sunset each day, or use with set times. Tap the play button to see a sped-up version of the scene.
smartScenes.preview.explanation.natureCo: Bring the best of nature inside with this outdoors-inspired All-day scene, which transitions automatically throughout the day. Once saved, tap the pencil icon next to the scene's card to edit each time slot.
